name: REVIVER v24
notes: PC stats is back as a built-in screen: CPU, GPU and disk, each as a temperature or a usage (pick in the Screens tab), plus the date and day. TENET Hub feeds it, so it only comes up while TENET Hub is running. Everything from v23: your own screen list, a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
